name: Salem County, NJ
findings: Salem County has 230 nonprofit organizations. 102 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Salem County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Salem County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 55 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 18 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list membership
observations.text: No hobby and sports organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 11 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
